integrity: Exact analytic BVP and renewal derivations; accompanying deterministic numerical matrix and finite-difference checks support but cannot certify infinitely many crossings.
scientific_limitations: Exactly one directed equal-rate three-conformation gate, a single absorbing state, half-line Brownian motion, Poisson resets, strictly positive rates and distance, initial stationary gate. Exact mean-time ordering does not imply entire-distribution ordering; remote sign reversals are exponentially small and may be difficult to observe experimentally. Published general gating and renewal equations may encode the result implicitly; no independent priority certification.
title: Infinitely many reset-protocol reversals for a cyclic three-conformation Brownian gate
